name: What should I look for in a good remodeling estimate?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in a good remodeling estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good remodeling estimate should be clear, detailed, and itemized. Look for a breakdown of labor, materials, permits, and any subcontractor costs. It should clearly define the scope of work, specifying what is and isn't included. A professional estimate will also include payment terms, a projected timeline, and information on warranty and insurance. Ensure it's in writing and addresses all aspects discussed during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A good estimate is clear, detailed, and itemized, breaking down labor, materials, and permits. It defines the scope of work, payment terms, and timeline, and should be in writing.
